speedMps.title: Apollo EVA walking: O2 use and speed
speedMps.note: "Oxygen use was about 0.16 lb/hr per 1000 BTU/hr"; "1560 BTU/hr at 3.5 km/hr" -> ~113 g/h = 0.031 g/s (o2GPerS). Emergency return "3.6 km/hr for periods of up to an hour" -> 1.0 m/s (speedMps). Moon 1/6 g, transferred to Mars 0.38 g.
speedMps.credit: E. M. Jones, Apollo Lunar Surface Journal

emergencyO2G.title: Emergency O2 reserve (EMU Secondary Oxygen Package)
emergencyO2G.note: NASA EVA overview (NTRS 20140009556): the EMU SOP "provides a minimum of 30 minutes of emergency O2". Grams = 1800 s x 0.031 g/s = 55.8 g. ISS suit, not a Mars suit.

time.title: EVA time limit
time.note: 3600 s demo limit (SPEC §7.4). For reference: EMU EVA up to 7 h (NTRS 20140009556).

o2.title: O2 available for this EVA
o2.note: 112 g = 1 h of walking x Apollo rate (0.031 g/s x 3600 s), same principle as SPEC §7.4; decision #20.

energy.title: Suit energy limit
energy.note: 600 Wh; not set in SPEC, no source.

dose.title: Radiation dose limit
dose.note: Unknown -> null -> budget status incomplete (SPEC §7.6); no point dose is spread over the map.

sources.title: Gale DEM 1 m (HiRISE stereo)
sources.note: Float32 TIFF via exportImage, nearest neighbour at native 1 m; mean of valid pixels per 10 m cell.

sources.title: Curiosity traverse (MMGIS)
sources.note: MSL_traverse.json clipped to bbox; line leaves bbox → split.

sources.title: THEMIS IR night, controlled mosaic 100 m v2 (Mars Odyssey)
sources.note: Trek WMTS PNG tiles, level 9 (~81 m/px), 1 tile(s); ~32x31 native pixels over the bbox, nearest per 10 m cell. 8-bit display brightness, not calibrated temperature. Display only, not an input to hazard (SPEC §8).
sources.credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech/Arizona State University, Mars Odyssey THEMIS; Mars Trek
